title: heze-devnet-2
announcements:
**Scope.** Next spec devnet on the **Heze** fork. Keeps [EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805) as shipped on [heze-devnet-1](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-1) and adds 3 new EIPs: EIP-8015 and EIP-8365 (CL only) and EIP-8198 (CL + EL).
Client images build from the common `heze-devnet-2` branch.
[bogota-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
